title: Point of view / perspective Practice 2
description: 4 short texts - 8 focused point of view / perspective questions
subject: rla
passage:
TEXT A - Lost Key

I watched Arun search every pocket twice. He laughed when I offered to help, but because he kept glancing toward the locked office, I suspected he was more worried than he sounded.

TEXT B - River Project

Engineers say a new floodwall would protect several low streets. Environmental groups argue that restoring wetland space could reduce water levels while providing habitat.

TEXT C - Gallery Review

The critic praises the exhibition's dim lighting as intimate. A visitor quoted later says the same lighting makes labels difficult to read.

TEXT D - Lunch Policy

The principal supports a shorter lunch line because it gives students more time to eat. A cafeteria worker agrees with the goal but says the proposed layout could block access to storage.
